notes.title: Meow Motors is becoming more accessible!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32794641/bc28ddb9c3f7f1221cb01bc1465a03c97f563a6f.jpg[/img]

Meow! We have a great news.

When Meow Motors was released on Steam, we set the best price for us and the players. But during the release on the PS4 were forced to put the amount less. 

It's time to restore justice. 

Now the max cost of Meow Motors on Steam and on PS4 is the same. So we have become even closer to the players.

* Max - taking into account regional factors.

notes.title: Hooray! Meow Motors is released! v1.0
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32794641/efc7e503a609db034e393e8bb82c25ff95f35f40.gif[/img]

[b]Meow Motors just moved from early access to a full release![/b]

We worked hard to make our first game as interesting and cute as possible! And thanks to you, my friends, it became so fast and furrious.
Thank you for all this time helping us to improve our game and our team. 
Your feedback and comments have become for us the main guideline and a great motivator of the game development.
We are going to continue actively support our game, to be sure you get maximum fun playing Meow Motors.

Me-Wow everyone!

notes.title: Introducing Update 0.96!
notes.content:
Our team constantly improve "Meow Motors", listening to your wishes and feedback.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32794641/91b04962acc292437a20f04320b6ff96fda33057.gif[/img]

[b]So, what's new this time:[/b]

1. Our kittens constantly learn new languages: we added Korean and Japanese ^ _ ^
2. Great news for achievement hunters! Previously, some achievements were impossible to get - we fixed related errors. Now you definitely can pass the game on all 100%.
3. We also added correct font support for some of languages.
4. A bunch of bugs were fixed, stability and game optimization was improved.

Thank you all for your support and your help with improving Meow Motors.

[b]Enjoy your game![/b]
Development team.

notes.title: Meet the Meow update 0.95!
notes.content:
We've been gathering your wishes and working on improving your furrrily gaming experience a lot :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32794641/70829d3c46d687dd6aeba0bebb0e27a2d1712741.gif[/img]

So this update includes:
1. New localizations. We've added German, French, Spanish & Chinese languages
2. Around 30 new musical tracks. Diving into cartoonish meow atmosphere has never been easier :)
3. New sounds. Your interaction with the environment will become more vivid
4. 'Fast race' regime changes. 
Four characters, four cars, all maps and weapons opened from the first start of the game in 'fast race'. Wanna go straight into action not being involved into Rocky's story? Meow problem!
5. Probability for power-ups generation on tracks changed. Being a bit random can be fun :)

And some technical improvements:
1. Balance changes on medium and difficult levels
2. Physics responsible for your interaction with the environment improved
3. Minor bugfixes
4. Other improvements & optimizations

Have a great meow time playing the game!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32794641/4cbafa75ac59708d6b31449d57867eac89719b30.gif[/img]
